{{Top}}
An '''onion''' was a type of [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]]. The young cook [[Merle]], serving aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Reliable]]'', smelled of onions while playing a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game once with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].
